notes: Pruned twice by Tidemark (2026-09-27). First pass removed ~100 Phase-1 candidates that were blog posts, RSS feeds, application forms, CSS/image assets or one-off URL-discovery artifacts. Second pass removed every target run to completion whose captures never yielded a real rate table (confirmed by inspecting the cached HTML, not just the parser's say-so -- see backfill/notes/sfb.md for what each one actually turned out to contain: Flash-banner pages, marketing landing pages with no table at all, React/Next.js SPA shells with zero rendered numbers, or genuine 404s). Only targets that produced at least one stored card, or that are a confirmed-real page still awaiting a savings-slab-capable script, remain below.

targets.note: Legacy domain (current site is au.bank.in). Retail FD rate-card page. Stored: 5 cards, 2023-12-23 to 2025-10-12, general customer only (see parser doc comment for the senior-citizen gap).
Older hub page before the personal-banking/ path restructure. Stored: 2 cards, 2019-08-18 to 2020-03-29.
Dedicated RD rate page. Stored: 7 cards, 2020-12-04 to 2023-09-26 (no Annualized-column duplication problem on this page, generic parser handles it directly).
Current-era callable retail FD page (matches the bank's live sourceUrl). Stored: 5 cards, 2024-04-08 to 2025-09-17.
Non-callable retail FD variant. Stored: 1 card, 2025-02-17 to 2025-05-19.

NOT run via run.ts (balance-slab page, not tenure-keyed -- see backfill/notes/sfb.md). Read instead by backfill/capital-sfb-savings-wayback.ts, which found a single flat rate (no tiers) covering every account type in every capture checked.

Combined rates hub (FD/savings/RD/FCNR all on one page per the live layout) -- generic parser only recovers the first tenure table (domestic FD). Stored: 14 cards, 2017-03-20 to 2025-05-01 -- by far the longest single-URL span found in this pass.

Needs the custom parser: the page's one table has FD Plus / Regular FD / Senior FD side by side, each as a Rate+Yield(Annualised) pair -- the generic reader tags 4 columns 'general' and 2 'senior', rejected outright by validateCard. Stored: 4 cards, 2019-08-26 to 2020-08-03.
Combined rates hub; generic parser recovers only the first tenure table. Stored: 6 cards, 2023-09-24 to 2025-06-14 (fills the gap after the fixed-deposit/ page above stops).

FD Plus (no premature withdrawal) is a DIFFERENT scheme from the bank's standard retail FD above, at different rates -- kept under product 'fd' since the schema has no separate slot for it, but every stored card carries this note so it is not mistaken for the standard card rate. Stored: 7 cards, 2019-07-18 to 2020-11-27.

Current-era combined rates page (post-SFB conversion, Apr 2021). Stored: 8 cards, 2023-06-03 to 2025-10-17. The pre-2021 Shivalik Mercantile Co-operative Bank era of this same domain (fixed-deposits, deposit-products, daily-deposits, deposits/savings/ paths, 2013-2020 captures) was checked and confirmed to carry no rate table at all in any capture -- see backfill/notes/sfb.md.

North East SFB (pre-rename) primary FD rate-table page. Stored: 3 cards, 2023-03-23 to 2024-10-05, immediately before the bank's own bank_archive PDF (previous_interest_rates.pdf, already loaded) takes over from Oct 2024.

North East SFB RD rate-table page. Stored: 2 cards, 2023-03-23 to 2024-04-22 -- the only RD history found anywhere in this group (the bank's own archive PDF has no RD section, and slice-sfb's live RD adapter only ever publishes the single current period).

Fincare SFB's own rates page (predecessor merged into au-sfb 1 Apr 2024). Stored under bankSlug fincare-sfb per data/banks/banks.json's predecessor slug: 28 cards, 2018-06-15 to 2022-11-27 -- the densest single-URL history found in this whole pass.

PMC Bank's own rate page, earliest confirmed capture Feb 1999. In scope per research brief: PMC's deposit rates count only when its own official pages are archived -- confirmed here. Stored: 1 card, 1999-02-10 to 1999-10-12.
Later ASP-era rate page, picking up where interest_rate.html leaves off. Stored: 17 cards, 2003-02-01 to 2011-12-09.

Later-era combined retail-banking interest-rates page, up to the Sep 2019 RBI restrictions. Stored: 10 cards, 2012-08-22 to 2019-10-15 -- the last revision found is 8 days before the 23 Sep 2019 RBI directions, so these are genuine pre-restriction live rates, not a frozen/notice page.
